title: Custom Middleware
definition: Writing your own custom middleware is incredibly common. It allows you to modularize reusable logic that needs to run before your route handlers. A custom middleware is just a function that accepts `req`, `res`, and `next`.

answers.question: When should you avoid using Custom Middleware?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
